definitions.explanation: Used to describe what typically happens or what is the standard situation. Slightly more formal than {普通|ふつう} or いつも.

definitions.gloss: the normal / regular state (noun, often as 通常の or 通常通り)
definitions.explanation: Used as a noun-modifier or adverbial phrase meaning "normal" or "as usual," especially in business and announcements: {通常|つうじょう}{通|どお}り (as usual), {通常|つうじょう}{営業|えいぎょう} (regular business hours).

examples.japanese: {通常|つうじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八時|はちじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: It usually starts at eight o'clock.

examples.japanese: {通常|つうじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: It's cheaper than the regular price.

examples.japanese: {通常|つうじょう}{通|どお}り⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
{通常|つうじょう}、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}します→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine is normally taken after meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧し、⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通常|つうじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: The system failure has been resolved, and we are now back to the normal state.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{先|さき}ほど{通常|つうじょう}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: The trains that had been delayed due to the typhoon returned to normal operation a short while ago.

notes:
{通常|つうじょう} means "normally," "usually," or "the regular state." It functions both as a noun and as an adverb. Compared with ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ (the most common everyday word for "usual"), {通常|つうじょう} is more formal and is heavily used in business, official announcements, news, and instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通常|つうじょう}{通|どお}り: as usual (very common in announcements)
- {通常|つうじょう}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: regular business hours
- {通常|つうじょう}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: normal operation (trains)
- {通常|つうじょう}{価格|かかく}: regular price
- {通常|つうじょう}{業務|ぎょうむ}: ordinary work / regular operations
- {通常|つうじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to normal
- {通常|つうじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: normally; usually (sentence-initial adverb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: usual, normal (most common everyday word; less formal)
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always (frequency-based, not register-marked)
- {通例|つうれい}: as a rule, ordinarily (literary)
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: generally
- ⟦{平常|へいじょう}→平常：25319_heijou⟧: usual, normal (appears in ⟦{平常時|へいじょうじ}→平常時：30259_heijouji⟧ "normal times" and in the "flat/calm" sense, e.g. ⟦{平常|へいじょう}{心|しん}→平常心：21200_heijoushin⟧ "calm mind")

USAGE:
- {通常|つうじょう}{通|どお}り is one of the most useful collocations for business announcements: "We are open as usual."
- The pair {通常|つうじょう}/⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧ (regular/special) is common in pricing and service descriptions: {通常|つうじょう}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧ vs ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧.
- In speech, ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ replaces {通常|つうじょう} casually: ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧~ (Normally ~).
